Package com.tonic.analysis.execution.listener

Class CompositeBytecodeListener

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.execution.listener.CompositeBytecodeListener
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    BytecodeListener
    public final class CompositeBytecodeListener
extends Object
implements BytecodeListener
    Listener that fans every event out to an ordered list of delegate listeners.
